goal: Assemble static end-to-end whole-product report without changing measurements or estimators

bootstrap.controller_injection_evidence: artifact://805; truncated orchestration section consumed through artifact://805:383-685
bootstrap.work_gate: ALLOW work: goals, reads, map and required evidence are current.

estimator.goodput: median of seven receiver-verified round application goodput rates; direction-specific
estimator.established_rtt: median of seven per-round medians, each of 256 monotonic 64B verified echo RTT samples
estimator.fresh_first_response: median of seven per-round medians, each of 8 fresh first verified response samples; prewarmed WG association
estimator.dispersion: inclusive linear Q1–Q3 over seven round values
estimator.exact_attributes: data-value=summary metric median; data-q1/data-q3=summary quartiles; data-metric=exact summary key
estimator.loss: median of seven per-round loss rates from summary-udp.json, never aggregate mislabeled as median

coverage: five workloads, four frozen products, separate TCP and UDP
limitations: whole-product dependency/protocol/lifecycle confounds; not isolated causal batching/GSO
same-host IPv4 loopback, not WAN; fixed support CPU0,1 may bottleneck
UDP includes exact100ms drain and reliable control overhead, not raw UDP/TCP-comparable capacity
TCP fwupd disappeared between passive snapshots; cause unobserved; no contemporary manual/container Xray PID before/after
checks_performed: Source inspection and controller bootstrap/work gate only. No measurements, builds, tests, linters, formatters or self-approval of report. Independent HTML/numeric validation is assigned to ResultAudit.
